claims.text: The hotel is on 56th Street at the south edge of Central Park, a short walk to Carnegie Hall and MoMA.

findings.quote: Poised on the south edge of Central Park, our 56th Street locale is a short walk to Carnegie Hall, MoMA and legendary fine dining destinations.

claims.text: The property was formerly The Parker and became a Thompson hotel in 2019.

findings.quote: The property was formerly The Parker, and became a Thompson hotel in 2019.

claims.text: The hotel closed during the pandemic for a thorough facelift and reopened in November 2021 as Thompson Central Park.

findings.quote: It closed during the height of the pandemic for a thorough facelift, reopening in November 2021 as the Thompson Central Park.

claims.text: The sleek, midcentury-feeling interiors were designed by Thomas Juul-Hansen.

findings.quote: The sleek, midcentury-feeling interiors were designed by Thomas Juul-Hansen.

claims.text: At Indian Accent, Chef Manish Mehrotra puts an inventive spin on classic Indian dishes.

findings.quote: With an artful approach to traditional Indian recipes, Chef Manish Mehrotra puts an inventive spin on classic dishes

claims.text: Parker's serves sharable dishes and inventive cocktails with live music.

findings.quote: Parker's rounds out our impressive gastronomic scene. Step into a moody, sophisticated setting where you can enjoy a playful menu of sharable dishes alongside inventive cocktails, with live music filling the air

claims.text: Burger Joint has graffitied walls and a no-frills hamburgers and fries menu.

findings.quote: Burger Joint welcomes guests to graffitied walls and unpretentious bites from its no-frills, flavorful hamburgers and fries menu.

claims.text: In-room dining is available around the clock.

findings.quote: our exemplary around-the-clock in-room dining ensures you can savor our culinary delights from the comfort of your own space

claims.text: Upper Stories rooms and suites are on the hotel's topmost guest floors, with access to the Upper Stories Lounge on the third floor.

findings.quote: a collective of rooms and suites perched on our topmost guest floors and features access to daily culinary celebrations hosted in the Upper Stories Lounge located on the third floor

claims.text: Upper Stories rooms include private check-in, a Dyson Supersonic hair dryer and a Nespresso Vertuo.

findings.quote: Offering exclusive access to the Upper Stories lounge with private check-in. This room features luxury in-room amenities including a Dyson Supersonic hair dryer and Nespresso Vertuo

claims.text: Rooms have 400-thread-count Italian linens and midcentury finishes.

findings.quote: crisp 400-thread-count Italian linens and chic midcentury finishes

claims.text: The exhale spa offers 60- and 90-minute massages, facials and body treatments.

findings.quote: Rejuvenate with our full-service, expertly curated spa menu of 60- and 90-minute massages, facials, and body treatments customized to your needs.

claims.text: Burger Joint is hidden behind a red curtain near reception, with a neon-lit burger above its entrance.

findings.quote: hidden behind a red curtain near reception and recognizable only by the neon-lit burger above its entrance

claims.text: Upper Stories rooms have their own Victrola record players.

findings.quote: All Upper Stories rooms also have their own Victrola record players

claims.text: exhale has a daily schedule of barre, yoga and HIIT classes alongside a fitness center.

findings.quote: Get a full-body sweat with our daily schedule of renowned barre, yoga, and HIIT classes or pop over to the accompanying fitness center for cardio, strength and free weights.

claims.text: A daily destination fee is applied to each room, subject to change.

findings.quote: A daily destination fee of $39.22 plus tax (subject to change) is applied to each room of your stay

claims.text: Parking is by valet at the hotel entrance, without in-and-out privileges.

findings.quote: Valet parking is available at the hotel entrance. Does not include in-and-out privileges.

claims.text: Burger Joint takes walk-ins and does not accept reservations.
